links.outcome: Readability (SMOG) and understandability/actionability (PEMAT-P) of LLM lung cancer answers
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o mini reached a sixth-grade level (SMOG 6.23 ± 0.72, p < 0.001) and highest PEMAT-P (63.7%); other models were less readable and all had moderate mDISCERN quality.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o mini demonstrated superior readability, achieving a sixth-grade level (SMOG: 6.23 ± 0.72, p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Presence of hallucinations in LLM lung cancer responses
links.effect: No hallucinations were observed across the 30 responses from the three LLMs.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, readability (SMOG), and understandability/actionability (PEMAT-P) of standard responses from ChatGPT-4o mini, Copilot, and Gemini to lung cancer questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
